description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger A creature within 30 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points or dies.

You raise that creature as an Afflicted immediately, before any other effect that triggers on its death or on its body resolves. This counts against your usual limit on Afflicted and costs whatever raising one ordinarily costs. If the creature is not a valid subject — it is not recently dead, or something protects it — the reaction is spent and nothing happens.

cinderfall.incomplete: Raising/creating a new minion or ally creature (P-SUMMON) has no system.rules representation. Real pf2e itself ships rules: [] for the equivalent case (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/spells/spells/rank-1/summon-undead.json, system.summons left unpopulated too), but per this pass's own convention that is evidence of the gap, not license to treat the clause as correctly-empty -- it is dispositioned INCOMPLETE, not SKIP. (reaction-triggered variant -- raise on 0 HP/kill within 30 ft, same unmodeled-actor-creation gap.)
